ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan: Environment
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build of Ancient & Medieval Japan: Environment.
Reworks RimWorld world generation toward a pre-Edo Japan-like environmental profile, including climate, terrain, rivers, coastlines, biomes, vegetation, weather, and seasonal scenery.
Ancient & Medieval Japan Core is not required.
